params.signal: z-scored log monthly spending total, 24 months of the observation window
params.candidate_pairs: the 50 nearest territories by stored road distance, symmetrized
params.distance_damping: exp(-d/600) on the stored road distance
params.weight: exp(-warping_distance / h) * exp(-d/tau), h = median warping distance
params.missing_months: left missing; a pair is scored only on months both territories have
params.direction: undirected weight, directed lead carried by the winning offset
params.sparsification: per-source top-k outgoing edges, k = 10 and 25

lead_lag.leaders_note: a territory counts as a leader on the pairs where it is the earlier one, so the count is over pairs and not over lag values

warping_validation.note: the bounded-lag form is not the same metric as full warping; the rank agreement is reported so the shortcut can be judged rather than trusted
